subject: Pricing & committed-use options - BrightScale
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightscale.ai>, Hannah Lee <hannah@brightscale.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & committed-use options - BrightScale

Hi Samir / Hannah,

Great to meet you both on the call earlier — thanks for walking through BrightScale's product & target roadmap. Quick recap and next steps on pricing / commitment options so we can align on economics for the pilot and scale.

Recap of what you shared:
- Pilot target: ~300M tokens/month initially (customer-facing generation workloads)
- Growth target: ~1B tokens/month within 9–12 months if pilot validates
- Typical request size: ~600–900 tokens per response (avg ~800)
- Primary requirement: predictable unit cost and an economical path to scale

A few questions to help us put together a clean committed-use proposal:
1) Do you have a target $/1M tokens range (ballpark) you need to hit to get approval from finance?
2) Any constraints on contract length (3mo pilot vs 12mo or multi-year)?
3) Who will own procurement / PO on your side?

What we can offer (high level):
- Startup program (early-stage discount): credits + reduced rates for the first 6–12 months for qualifying startups (we typically combine a credit + % off list). If you qualify, we can layer this on top of a committed discount.
- Committed-use tiers (examples):
  * 3-month pilot commit (300M tokens/month): preferential rate + onboarding credits
  * 12-month commit (sustained 1B tokens/month): deeper committed-use discount (significant $/1M reduction)
  * 2+ year multi-year: best-in-class pricing + implementation credits and SLA add-ons

I can put numbers behind these options once you confirm a target $/1M and which commitment length you'd prefer. From experience, customers in your stage often ask for a blended target in the $1,000–$1,500 / 1M tokens range — if that helps as a starting point.

Next steps:
- If you can reply with target $/1M and preferred commitment window, I’ll ask Ben and Rishi to prepare a formal quote (SOW + pricing spreadsheet) and include startup incentives if you qualify.
- We’ll also include a sample MSA term sheet for procurement review.

Attached: please share anything helpful (pricing model / deck) — I saw the note about a pitch deck; feel free to send it along.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0134

From: Samir Patel <samir@brightscale.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Lee <hannah@brightscale.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & committed-use options - BrightScale

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear summary — appreciate it. A few data points from our side to help you model pricing:
- Pilot: expecting ~300M tokens/month for the first 2–3 months
- Growth plan: target ~1B tokens/month within ~12 months if pilot goes well
- Budget target: roughly $1,200 / 1M tokens (ballpark) — finance would prefer <= $1,500 and ideally closer to $1,200
- Procurement: I own the vendor process, but procurement/legal will review contracts.

We’re an early-stage, seed-funded startup and would definitely be interested in any startup credits / program you offer. I’ve attached our internal pricing model and pitch deck to give context on volume growth and ARR targets.

Would be great to see a couple of concrete committed-use scenarios (pilot + 12mo) that hit ~ $1,200 / 1M or show the path to reach it with credits and committed discounts.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Engineering | BrightScale
samir@brightscale.ai

Attachments: BrightScale-Pricing-Model.xlsx, BrightScale-Pitch.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightscale.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & committed-use options - BrightScale

Thanks Samir — this is helpful. Based on the volumes you provided, here are two concrete options we can formally quote (we’ll put these in the spreadsheet and SOW):

Option A — Pilot + optional scale
- 3-month pilot commit: 300M tokens/month
- Effective blended rate w/ startup incentive: $1,350 / 1M tokens
- Included: onboarding credits for integration + 1 free health-check call
- Purpose: low-friction test to validate model fit and latency

Option B — Annual committed-use (recommended if you’re confident in 12mo growth)
- 12-month commitment targeting sustained 1B tokens/month
- Committed discount yields: $1,050 / 1M tokens (after committed-use discount + startup stacking where eligible)
- Included: $50k in implementation credits applied in first 3 invoices, priority support, SLA baseline

Option C — Multi-year incentive (2 years)
- 24-month commitment: deeper discount and fixed pricing cadence
- Example: $950 / 1M tokens + $75k credits + custom SLA and breakglass support

Notes:
- The startup program is qualification-based; if BrightScale qualifies we can stack credits and a transient % off for the first 6–12 months to help you hit your $/1M target earlier.
- Exact pricing will depend on model choice (smaller open models vs. larger foundation models) and usage pattern (peak concurrency). The numbers above assume a mix of generation-optimized variants with prefix/KV caching enabled.

Next steps:
- Ben / Rishi — can you prepare a formal quote (spreadsheet, SOW, and a redline-friendly MSA) that includes Option A/B/C? Please include a short note on assumptions (model profile, baseline latency, token definition) so engineering/procurement can evaluate.
- Samir — if you confirm which option you prefer, we’ll fast-track the draft quote and send a DocuSign link for signature and procurement review.

Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & committed-use options - BrightScale

Heads up — I’ll own the commercial quote for this deal (RD-2026-1398). Plan:
1) Build the formal pricing spreadsheet (lines for tokens, support, credits)
2) Draft SOW + MSA redline (procurement usually wants a 30-day review)
3) If they pick Option B, we’ll require a signed commitment + PO before credits auto-apply

Marissa — can you confirm startup qualification criteria for BrightScale (revenue/employee thresholds) so we can mark the quote accordingly? Rishi — please coordinate on legal terms; I’ll draft the HubSpot deal and prepare a DocuSign packet.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Samir Patel <samir@brightscale.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Lee <hannah@brightscale.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & committed-use options - BrightScale

Marissa / Ben — thanks for the options. BrightScale would like to move forward with Option B (12-month committed-use at ~$1,050 / 1M with the $50k implementation credits).

Two quick asks before we sign: 1) can the $50k credits be applied to the first two invoices (they need to show up on the invoice for accounting), and 2) can you send the formal quote + DocuSign link so procurement/legal can start review?

If you can send the packet today we’ll prioritize review on our side and aim to return a signed DocuSign within 72 hours.

Best,
Samir
